notes.title: Update v1.1 COMING SOON!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32261205/190d74bf65d72142aaac47c651967d06f63da780.png[/img]

We've listened to the community and we're making some much needed tweaks to difficulty settings, adding a ton of quality of life changes and for players who want more we're implementing a new way to play the game - Hero Mode!

Coming soon!!!
